en.title: Outfit Studio mixed-scene controls and recovery
en.body: Verify keyboard traversal and modal focus return on Windows, two-contact input and Android Home on Fold7, and transactional project and palette recovery on both hardware graphics backends. Add an executable mixed desktop keyboard regression.

zh.title: 换装工作室混合场景的操作与恢复
zh.body: 在 Windows 验证键盘遍历与模态焦点归还，在 Fold7 验证双触点操作与 Android 主屏中断，在两种硬件图形后端验证工程与配色的事务恢复。新增可复跑的混合桌面键盘回归。
